reference_sql:
WITH june_lines AS (  -- one row per June 2024 order line, as stored
  SELECT ol.order_id, ol.product_id, ol.quantity, ol.unit_price_eur, ol.promo_id, ol.line_discount_eur, p.unit_cost_eur, p.product_id AS known_product
  FROM order_lines ol
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  LEFT JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
  WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2024-06-01' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2024-07-01'
),
line_sets AS (  -- one row per set of matching June 2024 lines
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_lines
  FROM june_lines
  GROUP BY order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price_eur, promo_id, line_discount_eur
),
checks AS (  -- one row per check
  SELECT 'resent_copies' AS check_name, SUM(n_lines - 1) AS n_bad FROM line_sets
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'price_in_cents', COUNT(*) FROM june_lines WHERE unit_price_eur > 10 * unit_cost_eur
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'unknown_product', COUNT(*) FROM june_lines WHERE known_product IS NULL
)
SELECT check_name, n_bad, n_bad / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM june_lines), 0) AS bad_share,
       CASE WHEN n_bad = 0 THEN 'pass' ELSE 'fail' END AS result
FROM checks

solver.query:
WITH j AS (
  SELECT ol.order_id, ol.product_id, ol.quantity, ol.unit_price_eur, ol.promo_id, ol.line_discount_eur,
         ol.unit_price_eur > 10 * p.unit_cost_eur AS cents,
         p.product_id IS NULL AS unknown
  FROM order_lines ol
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  LEFT JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
  WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2024-06-01' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2024-07-01'
),
tot AS (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM j),
sets AS (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM j GROUP BY order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price_eur, promo_id, line_discount_eur),
chk AS (
  SELECT 'resent_copies' AS check_name, (SELECT SUM(n - 1) FROM sets) AS n_bad
  UNION ALL SELECT 'price_in_cents', (SELECT count(*) FROM j WHERE cents)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'unknown_product', (SELECT count(*) FROM j WHERE unknown)
)
SELECT check_name, n_bad, n_bad * 1.0 / (SELECT n FROM tot) AS bad_share, CASE WHEN n_bad = 0 THEN 'pass' ELSE 'fail' END AS result
FROM chk
